proposed_fixes.title: Peek PDF autoscroll does not show the expected cursor
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The PDF preview surface may handle middle-button autoscroll but not expose corresponding cursor state through its embedded preview control.
plan: Identify the PDF renderer/control and compare middle-button autoscroll and cursor updates with the system browser.
Apply appropriate cursor feedback on autoscroll start/move/end without changing PDF navigation behavior.
Add a UI regression test for cursor feedback during middle-button autoscroll.
verification: Open a PDF in Peek, press the wheel, move vertically, and verify the autoscroll cursor appears until the mode ends.

confidence.rationale: The preview control may not implement the same cursor feedback as a browser, but the expected cursor may be a platform behavior rather than a PowerToys requirement.
